name: cfreact-template
description: Full-stack template for Cloudflare Workers with React, Hono, and Drizzle ORM

scripts.build:backend: pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core build && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core-sdk build && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/main build:backend
scripts.gen:core: pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core gen:openapi && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core gen:api && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core-sdk gen:api
scripts.gen:api-sdk: pnpm --filter "./apps/**" --if-present gen:api && pnpm gen:core && prettier --write apps/main/typespec/openapi/openapi.json apps/main/src/frontend/api/generated/client.ts packages/core/typespec/openapi/openapi.json packages/core-sdk/src/generated/client.ts
scripts.check:codegen: pnpm gen:api-sdk && node scripts/codegen/verify-backend-handlers.mjs && node scripts/codegen/verify-backend-handlers.mjs --openapi packages/core/typespec/openapi/openapi.json --modules packages/core/src/modules --generated packages/core/src/generated/api && node scripts/codegen/verify-generated-artifacts.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- apps/main/typespec/openapi/openapi.json apps/main/src/backend/generated/api apps/main/src/backend/modules/*/handlers apps/main/src/frontend/api/generated/client.ts packages/core/typespec/openapi/openapi.json packages/core/src/generated/api packages/core/src/modules/*/handlers packages/core-sdk/src/generated/client.ts
scripts.migrate:apply: pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.toml --local
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm release:deploy-targets -- --targets all --environment production
scripts.test:e2e:backend: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm test:e2e:prepare-db && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/main exec wrangler dev -c wrangler.toml -c ../../packages/core/wrangler.toml --ip 0.0.0.0 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/e2e-state
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ui-reuse && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:openspec && pnpm lint:supply-chain
scripts.lint:eslint: eslint packages/ui && eslint apps/main && eslint . --ignore-pattern packages/ui --ignore-pattern apps/main
scripts.lint:openspec: pnpm exec openspec schema validate behavior-change && pnpm exec openspec schema validate architecture-change && pnpm exec openspec validate --all --strict && node scripts/openspec/verify-change-proposal.mjs && node scripts/openspec/verify-change-reuse-decisions.mjs && node scripts/openspec/verify-scenario-coverage.mjs && node scripts/openspec/verify-change-task-scope.mjs
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/main format:typespec && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core format:typespec && prettier --write "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,css,json,md,yml,yaml}" && terraform fmt -recursive infra/terraform
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/main format:typespec:check && pnpm --filter @cfreact-template/core format:typespec:check && prettier --check "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,css,json,md,yml,yaml}" && terraform fmt -check -recursive infra/terraform
